a.lede: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledged the special role Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has played in the AI boom, but ultimately thinks the industry will be “fine” without him at the helm.
a.title: Sam Altman on Nvidia without Jensen Huang: the industry will be ‘fine’

b.lede: Huang said in a statement that he “would be honored” to return as Nvidia CEO if the board of directors supported the decision.
b.title: Jensen Huang Says He’s Open to Coming Back to Nvidia
